title: Verify OpenGL installation and driver
summary: Check which OpenGL driver and version are currently active on your system using eglinfo or glxinfo. This confirms that your graphics drivers are correctly installed and functioning.

steps.explain: Run eglinfo to display the EGL and OpenGL API versions and the active renderer. This works on both X11 and Wayland.
steps.expect: Output showing 'OpenGL core profile renderer' and version details.

alternatives.explain: On X11 systems, you can also use glxinfo to check OpenGL details.
